# Sensemaking Lab

> Sensemaking Lab is a program evaluation and data consulting firm. We help organizations in education, healthcare, and the nonprofit sector turn complex data into clear findings they can act on.

We offer four services. Evaluation covers quantitative and qualitative program evaluation. Problem-solving consulting helps organizations work through operational and program challenges. Critical analytics is data analysis that asks how a dataset was made, what it measures, and whom it serves. Education support covers enrollment forecasting, student retention, accreditation, and reporting for colleges and universities.

The managing partners are Oscar J. Mayorga and Paul Martinez.

## Blog

- [How to Choose a Program Evaluator](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/how-to-choose-a-program-evaluator/): How to choose a program evaluator: what they do, internal vs. external trade-offs, the questions to ask, and the green and red flags to watch for.
- [What Is Critical Analytics?](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/what-is-critical-analytics/): Critical analytics is data analysis that asks how a metric was built, what it measures, and who benefits, not just what the numbers say. Here is what that means.
- [Student Retention Strategies That Work](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/student-retention-strategies-that-work/): Student retention strategies that move persistence: leading indicators, early-warning systems, wraparound support, and honest measurement that shows the gap.
- [Enrollment Forecasting 101](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/enrollment-forecasting-101/): Enrollment forecasting explained plainly: what it is, the main methods, the data you need, why to disaggregate, and the pitfalls that sink a projection.
- [Internal vs. External Evaluators: How to Decide](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/internal-vs-external-evaluators/): Internal vs. external evaluator: the honest trade-offs on cost, independence, capacity, and credibility, plus when to choose each and the hybrid middle path.
- [Outcomes vs. Outputs: Measuring Nonprofit Impact](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/outcomes-vs-outputs/): Outcomes vs outputs: outputs count activity, outcomes measure change. Learn the logic-model chain, why funders confuse them, and how to measure impact honestly.
- [What Institutional Research Actually Does](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/institutional-research/): Institutional research is the campus function behind reporting, accreditation, and student-success analytics. Here is what IR actually does and why it matters.
- [Building an Early-Warning System for Retention](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/early-warning-system-retention/): How to build an early-warning system for student retention: choose leading indicators, set thresholds, route every flag to a named owner, and close the loop.
- [Culturally Responsive Evaluation, Explained](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/culturally-responsive-evaluation/): Culturally responsive evaluation treats context, culture, and stakeholder voice as central to validity, not decoration. Here is what that means and why it matters.
- [How to Write the Evaluation Section of a Grant](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/evaluation-section-grant-proposal/): How to write the evaluation section of a grant proposal: questions tied to a logic model, mixed methods, indicators, timeline, and a real plan to use findings.
- [Qualitative vs. Quantitative: Which Method When](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/qualitative-vs-quantitative/): Qualitative vs. quantitative research, made practical. What each method answers well, the limits of each, and how to choose the method that fits your decision.
- [What a Program Evaluation Costs](https://www.sensemakinglab.io/blog/what-a-program-evaluation-costs/): What a program evaluation costs and why prices vary so widely. The real cost drivers, how to right-size the work, and how to compare quotes fairly.
